text_block_list.text:
The names of the two racecourses where the 
photos were taken both share "Naka" 
(Middle). And "#SkipTheMiddle" means if we 
take that out, we get "Kyo" and 
"Yama"—Kyoto and Nakayama!

"Furthermore, Nakayama had '#Opposite 
Sound' attached to it. The opposite of 
mountain (yama) is sea (umi), and reading 
its kanji in onyomi gives 'kai'. 
Connecting the two words gives us—"
choice_data_list:
“Kyou” and “kai” make “Church” [Kyoukai]! 
That's the answer!
